## beacon rules add

Install rule file(s) from a local path into the store

```
beacon rules add <path> [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --force    Overwrite an existing rule with the same id
  -h, --help     help for add
      --system   Use system endpoint paths
      --user     Use per-user endpoint paths (default true)
```
